description: sfxnz's GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4 kit (072c3f68, MIT) on two Sparks: the official nvidia/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 ModelOpt checkpoint at 09b04e5e with the incoai DFlash2 drafter (Apache-2.0; recorded for information) at 7d74cdd8, 7 drafted tokens, vLLM tensor-parallel 2 with the kit's patch chain glm53-sm121-v13 (NoPE MLA on sm_121, FlashInfer 0.6.18 nightly, DFlash2 backport, INT8 W8A16 target groups, NVFP4 W4A16 drafter, fixed-shape adaptive verify, indexer tail-ring fix) built on the 2026-08-26 push of vllm/vllm-openai:glm53-flash-arm64-cu130 (the base the kit's DFlash2 backport diff was made against; the tag has since moved). The creator's values are kept: 327,680-token window, fp8_e4m3 KV pinned at 4,445,787,956 bytes (4.14 GiB; the kit says the GB10 unified memory OOMs above about 5.1 GiB and refuses larger windows), two sequences, marlin MoE and linear backends, block size 2304, CUDA graphs 1/2/4/8/16, image (up to 4 per prompt) and video (1) input, output ceiling 65,536 tokens, thinking off by default (enable_thinking false) and switchable per request. The kit's MTP-4 rollback uses the LibertAI pack, which is different weights and so not offered here. Performance figures (prose decode 30.0 tok/s at 1 stream, 20.7 per stream at 2, step 73 ms, acceptance 2.2 tokens per step, creator's L.A.I.L lab, three boots 2026-09-28) are the creator's claims until measured here. Not yet tried on a Vonk Spark pair; the declared 120 GB per-rank peak follows the creator's README (MemAvailable stayed about 8 GiB of a 130.66 GB node under two concurrent 98k-token needles, i.e. about 122.1 GB in use, less the 2 GiB OS allowance = 119.9 GB; the loading-floor estimate is 115.8 GB) and the hardware try decides.
title: GLM 5.3 Flash NVIDIA NVFP4 DFlash2 sfxnz vLLM two Sparks
